arxiv-1901-08428.title: Cheap Orthogonal Constraints in Neural Networks: A Simple Parametrization of the Orthogonal and Unitary Group
arxiv-1901-08428.creator: Mario Lezcano-Casado, David Martínez-Rubio
arxiv-1901-08428.description: Abstract We introduce a novel approach to perform first-order optimization with orthogonal and unitary constraints. This approach is based on a parametrization stemming from Lie group theory through the exponential map . The parametrization transforms the constrained optimization problem into an unconstrained one over a Euclidean space, for which common first-order optimization methods can be used.

arxiv-2011-08728.title: Fault-Aware Robust Control via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2011-08728.creator: Fan Yang, Chao Yang, Di Guo, Huaping Liu, Fuchun Sun
arxiv-2011-08728.description: Abstract Robots have limited adaptation ability compared to humans and animals in the case of damage. However, robot damages are prevalent in real-world applications, especially for robots deployed in extreme environments. The fragility of robots greatly limits their widespread application.

arxiv-2109-05912.title: CoHaptics: Development of Human-Robot Collaborative System with Forearm-worn Haptic Display to Increase Safety in Future Factories
arxiv-2109-05912.creator: Miguel Altamirano Cabrera 1 , Juan Heredia 2 , Jonathan Tirado 1 , Vladislav Panov 3 , Fikre Hagos 1 , Dzmitry Tsetserukou 1
arxiv-2109-05912.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Miguel Altamirano Cabrera 1 , Juan Heredia 2 , Jonathan Tirado 1 , Vladislav Panov 3 , Fikre Hagos 1 , Dzmitry Tsetserukou 1. Complex tasks require human collaboration since robots do not have enough dexterity. However, robots are still used as instruments and not as collaborative systems. We are introducing a framework to ensure safety in a human-robot collaborative environment.

arxiv-2201-06877.title: Frequent Itemset-driven Search for Finding Minimum Node Separators in Complex Networks
arxiv-2201-06877.creator: Yangming Zhou, Xiaze Zhang, Na Geng, Zhibin Jiang, Mengchu Zhou
arxiv-2201-06877.description: Abstract Finding an optimal set of critical nodes in a complex network has been a long-standing problem in the fields of both artificial intelligence and operations research. Potential applications include epidemic control, network security, carbon emission monitoring, emergence response, drug design, and vulnerability assessment.

arxiv-2208-03466.title: Preventing or Mitigating Adversarial Supply Chain Attacks; a legal analysis
arxiv-2208-03466.creator: Kaspar Rosager Ludvigsen, Shishir Nagaraja, Angela Daly
arxiv-2208-03466.description: Abstract The world is currently strongly connected through both the internet at large, but also the very supply chains which provide everything from food to infrastructure and technology. The supply chains are themselves vulnerable to adversarial attacks, both in a digital and physical sense, which can disrupt or at worst destroy them.

arxiv-2305-16598.title: NormMark : A Weakly Supervised Markov Model for Socio-cultural Norm Discovery
arxiv-2305-16598.creator: Farhad Moghimifar, Shilin Qu, Tongtong Wu, Gholamreza Haffari
arxiv-2305-16598.description: Abstract Norms, which are culturally accepted guidelines for behaviours, can be integrated into conversational models to generate utterances that are appropriate for the socio-cultural context. Existing methods for norm recognition tend to focus only on surface-level features of dialogues and do not take into account the interactions within a conversation.

arxiv-2405-20361.title: HST SHEL: Enabling Comparative Exoplanetology with HST/STIS Facilities: HST (STIS), JWST (NIRSpec, NIRCam, NIRISS), TESS, NGTS, OHP:1.93m (SOPHIE), Euler1.2m (CORALIE, EulerCam), ESO:3.6m (HARPS), GTC (OSIRIS), TRAPPIST, Danish 1.54m Telescope, Magellan:Clay (MIKE)

Alam, Mercedes López-Morales, Kevin B. Stevenson, Hannah R. Wakeford, Erin M. May, Rafael Brahm, Marcelo Tala Pinto
arxiv-2405-20361.description: Abstract The Hubble Space Telescope (HST) has been our most prolific tool to study exoplanet atmospheres. As the age of JWST begins, there is a wealth of HST archival data that is useful to strengthen our inferences from JWST. Notably, HST/STIS and its 0.3-1 μ \mu m wavelength coverage extends past JWST’s 0.

arxiv-2407-04149.title: SineKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Using Sinusoidal Activation Functions Thanks: Citation : E.A.F. Reinhardt 1 , P.R. Dinesh, H.V. Nguyen, S. Gleyzer. SineKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Using Sinusoidal Activation Functions.
arxiv-2407-04149.creator: Eric A. F. Reinhardt, P. R. Dinesh, Sergei Gleyzer
arxiv-2407-04149.description: Abstract Recent work has established an alternative to traditional multi-layer perceptron neural networks in the form of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN). The general KAN framework uses learnable activation functions on the edges of the computational graph followed by summation on nodes. The learnable edge activation functions in the original implementation are basis spline functions (B-Spline).

arxiv-2411-11223.title: Efficient Transfer Learning for Video-language Foundation Models
arxiv-2411-11223.creator: Haoxing Chen, Zizheng Huang, Yan Hong, Yanshuo Wang, Zhongcai Lyu, Zhuoer Xu, Jun Lan, Zhangxuan Gu
arxiv-2411-11223.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Haoxing Chen, Zizheng Huang, Yan Hong, Yanshuo Wang, Zhongcai Lyu, Zhuoer Xu, Jun Lan, Zhangxuan Gu. Pre-trained vision-language models provide a robust foundation for efficient transfer learning across various downstream tasks. In the field of video action recognition, mainstream approaches often introduce additional modules to capture temporal information.

arxiv-2506-00145.title: Vedavani: A Benchmark Corpus for ASR on Vedic Sanskrit Poetry
arxiv-2506-00145.creator: Sujeet Kumar 1,2 , Pretam Ray 1 , Abhinay Beerukuri 1 , Shrey Kamoji 1 , \AND Manoj Balaji Jagadeeshan 1 , Pawan Goyal 1 1 Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur 2 B P Mandal College of Engineering, Madhepura {ksujeet.cs, pretamroy309, beerukuriabhinay, shreykamoji, manojbalaji1}@gmail.com pawang
arxiv-2506-00145.description: Abstract Sanskrit, an ancient language with a rich linguistic heritage, presents unique challenges for automatic speech recognition (ASR) due to its phonemic complexity and the phonetic transformations that occur at word junctures, similar to the connected speech found in natural conversations.

arxiv-2506-12630.title: Barchans interacting with dune-size obstacles: details of the fluid flow and motion of grains
arxiv-2506-12630.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We investigate details of the interaction of subaqueous barchans with dune-size obstacles by carrying out numerical simulations where the fluid is solved at the grain scale and the motions of individual grains are computed at all time steps. With the outputs, we analyze the disturbances of the fluid flow, the trajectories of grains, and the resultant force on each grain, the latter being unfeasible from experiments and field measurements.

arxiv-2507-06245.title: On the curvature bounded sphere problem in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3}

This result suggests a potential direction for a problem formulated by D.Burago and A.

pmc-10603400.title: Alarm burden and the nursing care environment: a 213-hospital cross-sectional study
pmc-10603400.creator: Halley Ruppel, Maura Dougherty, Christopher P Bonafide, Karen B Lasater
pmc-10603400.description: BackgroundHigh rates of medical device alarms in hospitals are a well-documented threat to patient safety. Little is known about organisational features that may be associated with nurses’ experience of alarm burden.AimsTo evaluate the association between nurse-reported alarm burden, appraisals of patient safety, quality of care and hospital characteristics.

pmc-11600941.title: The cultural adaption and validation of the Self-Regulated Learning Perception Scale (SRLPS) and the development of its short version in Chinese medical students
pmc-11600941.creator: Chunyu Xin, Xuemei Cui, Yuxin Song, Ruixue Zhang, Ning Ding, Deliang Wen
pmc-11600941.description: BackgroundSelf-regulated learning (SRL) is a pivotal skill in the digital era, closely correlating to academic performance and professional development, particularly within medicine, where rapid advancements in knowledge and technology demand continuous learning. The Self-Regulated Learning Perception Scale (SRLPS), validated for reliability and validity, is a critical tool for assessing SRL among medical students.

pmc-11608343.title: Predicting risk factors for postoperative intestinal stenosis in neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis: development and assessment of a predictive nomogram
pmc-11608343.creator: Yang Chen, Ling Zhou, Qianghui Liao, Dong Xiao, Ledao Zhu, Jinlong Yao, Jiashu Liu, Xuling Zhang, Xiaopeng Ma, Feng Ren, Zhiyong Wang
pmc-11608343.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to develop and validate an intestinal stenosis prediction model for postoperative newborns with neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC). MethodsClinical information was collected on neonates who had undergone anastomosis or enterostomy because of NEC. The least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression was applied to identify risk factors included in the model for postoperative intestinal stenosis.

pmc-13391403.title: Microbial bioactive complex supplementation is associated with gut microbial fermentation and feed conversion in weaned piglets
pmc-13391403.creator: Mi Ae Park, Soyeon Park, Hee Seop Yu, Da Jung Lim, Seoyun Son, Yong Hee Yoon, Dae-Hyuk Kim, Yangseon Kim
pmc-13391403.description: Improving feed efficiency while maintaining gut stability is a key nutritional objective during the post-weaning period in piglets. This study investigated the effects of dietary supplementation with a microbial bioactive complex (MBC), composed of Pediococcus pentosaceus CACC616, Lactobacillus reuteri CACC607, L. dextrinicus CACC889, L. pentosus CACC891, and Saccharomyces cerevisiae CACC699, on feed efficiency and gut microbial fermentation in weaned piglets.

pmc-13512761.title: Diminished Prognostic Value of Interim PET in Hodgkin Lymphoma Treated with Brentuximab Vedotin Plus AVD: A Retrospective Analysis
pmc-13512761.creator: Kareem Latif, Isaiah Courtad, Avery Stuart, Faisal Ansari, Ravand Samaeekia, Mojtaba Akhtari
pmc-13512761.description: Background: Interim PET after two cycles (PET2) has historically guided risk-adapted therapy in Hodgkin lymphoma (HL). Its value with frontline brentuximab vedotin plus doxorubicin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine (BV + AVD) is uncertain, as BV + AVD improves progression-free survival and may reduce the prognostic relevance of early metabolic response.

pmc-13680583.title: Swin-WaveNet: frequency-guided boundary restoration for robust skin lesion segmentation
pmc-13680583.creator: Zhiping Dan, Run Zhang, Tinglong Tang, Yirong Wu, Xiaosheng Yu, Shuifa Sun, Ben Wang
pmc-13680583.description: Accurate skin lesion segmentation remains difficult when dermoscopic boundaries are fragmented by hair occlusion, uneven illumination, or weak local contrast. To address this problem, the authors propose Swin-WaveNet, a frequency-guided encoder-decoder that combines a Swin Transformer backbone with wavelet decomposition and selective state-space modeling.
